title: Cerebras sinks 14% as full-year margin forecast disappoints
title_zh: 由于全年利润率预期令人失望，Cerebras 股价下跌 14%
summary: Cerebras shares tumbled about 14% before the bell on Wednesday after the chip designer warned that annual profit margins ‌would undershoot first-quarter figures in its debut earnings following a ‌blockbuster initial public offering.
summary_zh: 周三盘前，Cerebras 股价下跌约 14%，此前这家芯片设计公司警告称，在进行了大规模首次公开募股后，其首次公开募股的年度利润率将低于第一季度的数据。

title: Big Tech's $2.7 trillion AI bill comes due: Chart of the Day
title_zh: 大型科技公司 2.7 万亿美元的人工智能账单即将到期：每日图表
summary: The “Magnificent Seven” plus Broadcom and Oracle have lost roughly $2.7 trillion in market value in June, according to Yahoo Finance analysis, as investors take a harder look at the companies funding the AI build-out.
summary_zh: 根据雅虎财经的分析，“七大巨头”加上博通和甲骨文在 6 月份的市值损失了约 2.7 万亿美元，因为投资者更加仔细地审视了为人工智能建设提供资金的公司。

title: Micron Earnings Take on New Gravity With Market on Edge Over AI
title_zh: 随着市场对人工智能的关注，美光的盈利呈现出新的吸引力
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Micron Technology Inc.’s earnings report on Wednesday afternoon is shaping up to be one of the most important in months as investors find themselves suddenly on edge over the sustainability of the AI rally.Most Read from BloombergStocks Slide as Wall Street Gets...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——周三下午，美光科技公司（Micron Technology Inc.）的盈利报告将成为数月来最重要的盈利报告之一，因为投资者突然发现自己对人工智能涨势的可持续性感到紧张。彭博社的大多数报道随着华尔街股市的下跌...

title: ByteDance Seeks $20 Billion in Its Largest-Ever Offshore Loan
title_zh: 字节跳动寻求有史以来最大一笔离岸贷款 200 亿美元
summary: (Bloomberg) -- ByteDance Ltd., the developer of TikTok, is in preliminary talks with banks for a borrowing of about $20 billion, people familiar with the matter said, in what would be the firm’s largest offshore loan yet at a time when it’s boosting investments in artificial i...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——据知情人士透露，TikTok 开发商字节跳动正在与银行就约 200 亿美元的借款进行初步谈判，这将是该公司在加大对人工智能的投资之际迄今为止最大的一笔离岸贷款。

title: Stock market today: S&P 500, Nasdaq eye rebound from tech rout with Micron in focus
title_zh: 今日股市：标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克指数从科技股溃败中反弹，美光成为焦点
summary: Investors are braced for Micron earnings for clues to whether AI optimism has overrun.
summary_zh: 投资者等待美光科技的财报，从中寻找人工智能乐观情绪是否过度的线索。

title: The lessons that wearable tech companies can learn from FitBit
title_zh: 可穿戴技术公司可以从 FitBit 中吸取教训
summary: Health Tech Advisory and Industry Analyst Stephanie Davis comes on Market Domination to assess the state of the wearable technology industry, commenting on the lessons that the companies in this space can learn from FitBit's past.
summary_zh: 健康技术咨询和行业分析师斯蒂芬妮·戴维斯 (Stephanie Davis) 在市场支配地位上评估了可穿戴技术行业的状况，并评论了该领域的公司可以从 FitBit 的过去吸取的教训。

title: Tesla leads Cars.com's 'Most American' car title yet again, and now tariffs play a part
title_zh: 特斯拉再次领先 Cars.com 的“最美国”汽车称号，现在关税发挥了作用
summary: Tesla's (TSLA) Model 3 and Model Y lead Cars.com's "American-made Index" for the sixth year in a row. Yahoo Finance Senior Autos Reporter Pras Subramanian breaks down the details.
summary_zh: 特斯拉 (TSLA) 的 Model 3 和 Model Y 连续第六年领先 Cars.com 的“美国制造指数”。雅虎财经高级汽车记者 Pras Subramanian 详细分析了这些细节。
